title: View Trigger Definition
description: Learn various ways to view trigger definitions using system views and stored procedures.

data.text: SQL Server provides several ways to view the definition of a trigger, including system catalog views and stored procedures.

data.title: Query sys.sql_modules for trigger definition
data.content: Retrieves the trigger definition using the system catalog.
data.code:
SELECT
    definition
FROM
    sys.sql_modules
WHERE
    object_id = OBJECT_ID('sales.trg_members_delete');

data.title: sp_helptext for trigger definition
data.content: Returns the definition of a trigger using the sp_helptext stored procedure.

data.text: In SQL Server Management Studio, expand the table's Triggers folder, right-click the trigger, and select Modify to view its definition in the query window.

data.title: View Trigger Definition Key Points
points: sys.sql_modules stores the definition of triggers and other modules.
sp_helptext is a convenient stored procedure for viewing object definitions.
SSMS provides a GUI way to view and modify trigger definitions.
All three methods return the same trigger definition text.
